title: Towards Transparency: Exploring LLM Trainings Datasets through Visual Topic Modeling and Semantic Frame

bias_targets.methodology: Applying Semantic Framing Cartography to measure the alignment of document embeddings along semantic conceptual axes (e.g., 'past' vs. 'future', 'work' vs. 'leisure', 'politics' vs. 'business') using cosine similarity to detect dataset imbalance.

Using Semantic Framing Analysis to project document embeddings onto a 'men/women' semantic axis and evaluating skewed associations with other frames such as 'work' vs. 'leisure' and 'past' vs. 'future'.
